info.name: Request a bulk award data download

items.docs: Begins generating a zip file of award data in CSV, TSV, or pipe-delimited text form for download. Poll /bulk_download/status/ with the returned file_name to check completion.

params.name: file_name
params.description: The file name returned by the download-request endpoint.

items.docs: Returns the generation status and download URL (once ready) for a previously requested bulk download file.

info.name: List agencies available for bulk download

items.docs: Returns the toptier and subtier agencies that can be used to scope a bulk award or account download.
